peer_identity.arc_label: Honorata reincarnated inside Oda's body—merged identity raising Steelhead as warrior
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Commands Steelhead to defend clan honor; publicly identifies as 'widow of Othon von Salza and mother of Aghnar von Salza.' Raises Steelhead as warrior capable of killing Aghnar. Accepts Aghnar's binary choice ('the Castakas must continue'). Voice of Oda's body but Honorata's will and doctrine. Ended via suicide mini-bomb with Aghnar in vol11 after Steelhead's treachery.
peer_identity.rationale: Merges records from both character_ids 'honorata' and 'oda' because from vol09 onward the canonical description is 'Honorata's spirit within Oda's restored body'—these records describe the same composite entity. The vol09-10 'oda' records explicitly state Honorata supplanted Oda's identity. The vol11 'honorata' record describes her being mutilated and dying with Aghnar by mini-bomb as part of this merged body. Distinct from the living Honorata (active trainer) and the reborn Honorata (time-fissure strategist) because this persona's goal is raising Steelhead as warrior and she overrides the prior Aghnar/Oda pact against warrior succession.
